source: FinBERT2 (ValueSimplex, KDD 2025); Bloomberg meta-analysis of 681 financial NLP papers 2022-2025
title: H422 — FinBERT2 Model Upgrade for H174 PEAD Pipeline
rationale: FinBERT2 (KDD 2025, 32B finance-specific tokens) dominates ProsusAI/FinBERT across a meta-analysis of 681 financial NLP papers from 2022–2025. As a drop-in replacement in pead_overnight.py, it could improve the sentiment scoring accuracy above the current H174 threshold (OOS WR=81.8%). The model must become publicly available via HuggingFace before implementation. This proposal notes the upgrade path and adds H422 to the hypothesis log.
content: H422 is already documented in the pead.md expansion (2026-07-20). The upgrade path: replace `ProsusAI/finbert` with `valuesimplex/finbert2` (when publicly available on HuggingFace). Side-by-side IS comparison required before replacing live pipeline. Classification threshold may need recalibration from 0.18.
